description: The image displays two pie charts, labeled (a) and (b), representing the proportional distribution of specific text-based categories. Chart (a) consists of six slices and includes a legend positioned directly above it. The segments in chart (a) are arranged in clockwise descending order of size, starting from the top right: the largest slice, labeled "the", is blue with diagonal stripes (31%); followed by "this", which is blue with horizontal stripes (21%); "for", which is green with a crosshatch pattern (17%); an unlabeled category corresponding to a solid grey box in the legend, shown in the chart as light green with a dotted pattern (15%); "to", which is yellow with a wavy pattern (9%); and "in", which is light blue with vertical stripes (7%). Chart (b) contains four slices, also featuring a legend above the chart and segments ordered clockwise in descending size. Its largest slice is "the", colored blue with diagonal stripes (38%), followed by "$", which is pinkish-red with a dotted pattern (27%); "equilibrium", which is yellow with a wavy pattern (19%); and "consatant", which is grey with a dotted pattern (15%). In both charts, the percentage values are placed outside the slices adjacent to their respective segments, and neither chart contains any visually emphasized, offset, or exploded slices.
